 Print Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' is doing well at the box office and is almost reaching Rs 500 crore in the domestic market. This film, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, has stayed in most theaters even after the two-week release. The action sequel has benefited from its multi-language release and the star power of its leading cast. Although daily collections have slowed during the third week, the film has added to its impressive total. Jailer 2 Movie Review ‘Jailer 2’ India box office collection crosses Rs 424 crore net
 According to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' opened with Rs 59.70 crore on its first day and continued its strong run during the opening week. The film collected Rs 334.35 crore during its opening week, followed by Rs 89.67 crore in its second week. Its strong first-week performance gave the Rajinikanth-starrer a solid start, while the second-week earnings added to its overall box office total. However, daily collections have slowed as the film enters its third week. Watch Rajinikanth's Dharman Speech Reignites Discussions Around His Equation With Vijay ‘Jailer 2’ Day 15 Live box office collection
 On Day 15, 'Jailer 2' is running across 8,938 tracked shows and has earned Rs 4.25 crore net so far. The Tamil version remains the biggest contributor, collecting Rs 2.34 crore from 3,781 shows. The Telugu version has added Rs 1.13 crore through 1,531 shows, while the Hindi version has earned Rs 0.78 crore from 3,626 shows. Together, the three versions account for the film’s current live daily total. ‘Jailer 2’ day-wise box office collection
 Week 1: Rs 334.35 crore Day 8: Rs 17.15 crore Day 9: Rs 14.50 crore Day 10: Rs 24.15 crore Day 11: Rs 25.70 crore Day 12: Rs 9.45 crore Day 13: Rs 7.50 crore Day 14: Rs 6.55 crore Day 15: Rs 4.25 crore Total India net: Rs 427.25 crore Total India gross: Rs 500.01 crore About 'Jailer 2'
 Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, 'Jailer 2' features Rajinikanth as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian. The cast also includes Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan , Jackie Shroff, Mithun Chakraborty, S. J. Suryah and Yogi Babu . Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music for the sequel. As the film continues its third-week run, its upcoming collections will determine whether it can maintain its momentum and move closer to the Rs 1,000 crore worldwide milestone. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. This data is provided by us for informational and entertainment purposes only.
